sideA.text:
This is your first Turning Point card.
After reading it, place it into the Game End area.

sideB.text:
FORSAKEN CITIES

If there is at least one city with 0 population, open A 12 and destroy this card.

Put this card into the Game End area each game until it is destroyed.
sideB.footer: Put this card into the Game End area each game until it is destroyed.

mechanics.whenRead: Drawn during the January setup draw, after the two mandatory objectives and before the January Pause. After reading it, put it in the Game End area.
triggers: Each game, at Game End, if at least one city has 0 population
destroys: this card, when the 0-population condition is met
rules: Place this card in the Game End area after reading it, and again each game until it is destroyed.
If there is at least one city with 0 population, open A 12 and destroy this card.
mechanics.notes: The thing to open is printed as two separate cream badges with red characters: the letter A, then the number 12. 'A' and '12' are not one glyph.
